treatment_summary: Increase losartan to 50 mg daily and add amlodipine 5 mg if BP remains ≥140/90 mmHg after 4 weeks (NG136). Start atorvastatin 20 mg daily for primary ASCVD prevention (CG181/PH46). Initiate metformin 500 mg nightly, titrating to 500 mg BID, to treat pre‑diabetes (NG28). Add intranasal fluticasone for chronic sinusitis and continue diphenhydramine PRN. Avoid NSAIDs and high‑dose thiazides due to CKD. Monitor BP, renal function, potassium, liver enzymes, HbA1c and lipids as per NICE timelines.
